verdict.rationale: Vue is a client-side framework whose core source is public on GitHub (vuejs/core) and published to npm. A hands-on user notes you can simply download vue(.min).js and run it with no package manager, bundler or vendor service, so the whole product runs on infrastructure you control. missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation of the open-source license and of self-hosting/vendoring the runtime, and stronger independent corroboration beyond a single community comment.
